cohort: 9 women diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum disorder
finding: This retrospective audit of 9 women with placenta accreta spectrum found a high rate of caesarean hysterectomy (78%) but no maternal deaths.
mod_finding: All women diagnosed with Placenta Accreta Spectrum disorder in this study received caesarean section.
